title: Kernel transforms on defensive sources and the cost of suppression
description: EA-MANDALA-KERNEL-TRANSFORM-01 v0.2 makes worked examples protocol canon, predicts the transform's effect will be most acute on defensively composed sources such as John 1, and gives reopening conditions. claims.statement: Note on iteration: regime effects are cumulative. Repeated R2 exposure lowers resistance and cheapens subsequent predatory burns (desensitization). Repeated R1 exposure normalizes thinness and raises the threshold for density perception (habituation). The long-term commons effect is a function of the cumulative regime profile, not any single event.
